messages:
Priya S.: quick check — ACME legal signed a contract addendum for Feature-X. They want the feature enabled only for their accounts and 3 VIP seats. plan is per-customer flag + allowlist. thoughts on rollout and safe fallbacks?
Ethan L.: sounds fine. prefer account-level flag (not org-wide percent). rollout options: either enable for specific account IDs or do 1% traffic canary scoped to requests from ACME accounts. for VIP seats do explicit allowlist. also add a hard kill-switch.
Nadia R.: +1 for explicit allowlist for VIPs. also add monitoring: metric for "feature_x_enabled_requests" + error-rate and latency. alert if error-rate > 2% for 5m.
Priya S.: Ethan, can you paste a suggested flag config json we can hand to product/legal?
Ethan L.: sure — draft (pseudo):
```
{
  "flag_key": "feature_x_per_customer",
  "scope": "customer",
  "customers": ["acme-inc"],
  "vip_users": ["acme-inc:user:123", "acme-inc:user:456", "acme-inc:user:789"],
  "rollout": {"type": "explicit", "mode": "allowlist"},
  "fallback_policy": {"on_error": "model-small-v1", "on_disabled": "model-default"},
  "kill_switch": true
}
```
Jun P.: implementation notes: runtime already supports customer-scoped flags but we need two small infra changes: 1) fast path to check allowlist in the routing layer (avoid DB hit for every token) — use LRU cache with 1m TTL; 2) ensure fallback model variant is registered in model catalog mapping. also add audit log entry whenever flag toggled for an account.
Nadia R.: one more: if ACME is on Dedicated, routing should prefer their dedicated pool even when fallback triggers. confirm with infra team.
Ethan L.: agree. also recommend canary period with manual approval: enable for 1 account (ACME staging) for 24h, check metrics, then flip VIP seats. only after that flip full account. keep automatic rollback if latency/error thresholds breached.
Priya S.: sounds good. action items I have: 1) Ethan to create the flag proto and PR for UI toggle + kill switch (ETA EOD tomorrow). 2) Jun to add LRU cache + audit log (ETA Wed). 3) Nadia to add alerts and dashboard tiles (ETA Thu). 4) ops: confirm dedicated-pool priority mapping.
deploy-bot: deploy job #deploy-812 succeeded to staging :white_check_mark:
Ethan L.: will open PR and add the example config to the customer onboarding doc. tagging @Jun P. for cache review.
Jun P.: will prototype cache tonight, pinging infra for perf numbers.
Priya S.: thanks team. tagging legal/product to confirm VIP seat list format — @product-team @legal-team :thumbsup:
Nadia R.: adding dashboard card to the "Per-customer flags" page now.
Priya S.: closing the loop here — will post final checklist and sign-off once PRs are merged. :raised_hands:
